tools.name: assignar_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (jobs and bookings). Filter by client, status, dates or any field. GET /v2/orders.

tools.name: assignar_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List order statuses, with the status ids that orders use. GET /v2/order-statuses.

tools.name: assignar_list_order_types
tools.description: List order types, with the type ids that orders use. GET /v2/order-types.

tools.name: assignar_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers). GET /v2/clients/.

tools.name: assignar_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people linked to clients, projects or orders). GET /v2/contacts/.

tools.name: assignar_list_projects
tools.description: List projects. GET /v2/projects/.

tools.name: assignar_list_users
tools.description: List users (workers and staff). GET /v2/users.

tools.name: assignar_list_allocations
tools.description: List allocations: which user or asset is booked on which order, and when. GET /v2/allocations.

tools.name: assignar_list_timesheets
tools.description: List timesheets with expanded details (worker, order, times, charge codes). GET /v2/timesheets-expanded.

tools.name: assignar_list_assets
tools.description: List assets (plant, vehicles and equipment). GET /v2/assets.

tools.name: assignar_list_leave_requests
tools.description: List leave requests. GET /v2/leave-requests.

tools.name: assignar_list_site_diaries
tools.description: List site diaries. Filter by site_diary_date in filters. GET /v2/site-diaries/.

tools.name: assignar_list_form_results
tools.description: List submitted form results (dockets and forms). GET /v2/form-results.

tools.name: assignar_list_skills
tools.description: List skills that users can hold and tasks can require. GET /v2/skills.

tools.name: assignar_list_inductions
tools.description: List inductions (site safety training records). GET /v2/inductions.

tools.name: assignar_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id. GET /v2/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: assignar_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id. GET /v2/clients/{clientId}.

tools.name: assignar_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id. GET /v2/projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: assignar_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id. GET /v2/users/{userId}.

tools.name: assignar_get_timesheet
tools.description: Get one timesheet with expanded details. GET /v2/timesheets-expanded/{id}.

tools.name: assignar_get_asset
tools.description: Get one asset by id. GET /v2/assets/{assetId}.

tools.name: assignar_create_client
tools.description: Create a client (customer) in Assignar. Needs name and company_name. Writes live data. POST /v2/clients/.

tools.name: assignar_create_order
tools.description: Create an order (a job or shift booking). Needs client_id, order_owner (a user id), start_date and end_date, as the API expects them (e.g. 2026-12-01). Writes live scheduling data. POST /v2/orders.
